clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, young crocolisks provide hides for trade from Menethil Harbor. Their softer skins are cured by local tanner James Halloran and shipped to distant ports.

Menethil Harbor sends marsh goods to distant ports from the western coast of Khaz Modan. The town’s resident tanner, James Halloran, cures hides among its most lucrative exports. Full-grown crocolisks have thick, tough scales, while their young provide softer leather that is easier to work. The delicate skins are in high demand, so Halloran depends on local hunters and passing travelers to search the boggy marshes just outside town and keep his curing racks stocked.
